description: This file declares the interface for rbus message handling, including functions for creating, retaining, releasing, serializing, deserializing, and manipulating rbusMessage objects and their data types.

methods.name: rbusMessage_Retain
methods.description: Increments the reference count of an rbusMessage object.

methods.name: rbusMessage_Release
methods.description: Decrements the reference count, freeing the object if it reaches zero.

methods.name: rbusMessage_FromBytes
methods.description: Deserializes an rbusMessage from a byte buffer.

methods.name: rbusMessage_ToBytes
methods.description: Serializes an rbusMessage into a byte buffer.

methods.name: rbusMessage_ToDebugString
methods.description: Produces a debug string representation of an rbusMessage.

methods.name: rbusMessage_SetString
methods.description: Sets a string value in the message.

methods.name: rbusMessage_GetString
methods.description: Retrieves a string value from the message.

methods.name: rbusMessage_SetBytes
methods.description: Sets a byte array in the message.

methods.name: rbusMessage_GetBytes
methods.description: Retrieves a byte array from the message.

methods.name: rbusMessage_SetInt32
methods.description: Sets a 32-bit integer in the message.

methods.name: rbusMessage_GetInt32
methods.description: Retrieves a 32-bit integer from the message.

methods.name: rbusMessage_GetUInt32
methods.description: Retrieves a 32-bit unsigned integer from the message.

methods.name: rbusMessage_SetInt64
methods.description: Sets a 64-bit integer in the message.

methods.name: rbusMessage_GetInt64
methods.description: Retrieves a 64-bit integer from the message.

methods.name: rbusMessage_SetDouble
methods.description: Sets a double-precision float in the message.

methods.name: rbusMessage_GetDouble
methods.description: Retrieves a double-precision float from the message.
